title: 🌌 Pulsing Cosmic Shape with JavaScript Canvas ✨
description:
I’ve crafted a Pulsing Cosmic Shape using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! This project generates a hypnotic, ever-shifting form made of layered, semi-circular lines that pulse and twist over time. Rendered on a black canvas with a glowing purple hue, it’s a mesmerizing blend of math and art! 🎨

  • What’s it about? A dynamic shape evolves through sine-based oscillations and perspective scaling, creating a 3D-like effect.

  • The result? A glowing, fluid form that feels alive and otherworldly.

  • Main key of the code: The generatePoints and calculateZOffset functions use trigonometry Math.sin, Math.cos) to define the shape, while renderShape scales and draws it.

  • How can users benefit? Use it as a striking visual centerpiece, tweak colors or scale for customization, or explore parametric animation techniques!
shortDescription: 💫 A pulsing, cosmic shape glows and shifts, built with JS Canvas. Perfect for artistic visuals!
